codex.velorise_staves.title: Elemental Codex — Velorise's Staves Guide
codex.velorise_staves.diagram.environmen: World Physics: Ice Melting, Fire & Water
codex.velorise_staves.basics.card1.title: How Elemental Combat Works (No Genshin Knowledge Needed)
codex.velorise_staves.basics.card1.p1: • Step 1 — Apply an Aura (Paint the Target): Hitting an enemy with an elemental staff attaches an Element Icon above their head (called an 'Aura', lasting ~9.5s).
codex.velorise_staves.basics.card1.p2: • Step 2 — Trigger a Reaction (Detonate): While the target has an Aura icon overhead, hit them with a DIFFERENT element to trigger a powerful Elemental Reaction!
codex.velorise_staves.basics.card1.p3: • Visual Feedback: Overhead icons blink during their final 3 seconds before expiring. Reaction names and colored damage numbers pop up on impact.
codex.velorise_staves.basics.card2.title: Aura Strength (1.0U / 1.5U / 2.0U Gauge Units)
codex.velorise_staves.basics.card2.p1: • Think of 'U' (Gauge Units) as the battery capacity of an elemental Aura:
codex.velorise_staves.basics.card2.p2: • Basic Staves apply 1.0U (9.5s duration). Netherite Staves apply 1.5U–2.0U (12s–16.5s duration), letting you trigger multiple reactions before the Aura runs out.
codex.velorise_staves.basics.card2.p3: • Strong reactions (like Water on Fire x2.0) consume the entire Aura at once, whereas mild reactions (like Fire on Water x1.5) only consume half!
codex.velorise_staves.basics.card3.title: Innate Elemental Mobs & Natural Mutation
codex.velorise_staves.basics.card3.p1: • Innate Auras: Certain mobs permanently carry an element (Blaze = Pyro, Drowned/Guardian = Hydro, Stray = Cryo, Breeze = Anemo, Warden/Golem = Geo). Just hit them with 1 opposing staff to react immediately! Hitting them with their own element deals IMMUNE (0 damage).
codex.velorise_staves.basics.card3.p2: • Natural Mutation: Normal mobs have a 6% chance (configurable) to spawn mutated with a permanent random Elemental Aura.
codex.velorise_staves.elem.pyro.title: Pyro (Fire) — High Burst, Burning & Ice Melting
codex.velorise_staves.elem.pyro.p1: • Combat Role: Triggers Vaporize (with Hydro), Melt (with Cryo), Overloaded explosions (with Electro), Burning (with Dendro), and Burgeon (on Dendro Cores).
codex.velorise_staves.elem.pyro.p2: • Innate Creatures: Blaze, Magma Cube. Melts ice/snow and ignites flammable blocks & TNT.
codex.velorise_staves.elem.hydro.title: Hydro (Water) — Wet Aura & Reaction Enabler
codex.velorise_staves.elem.hydro.p1: • Combat Role: Core enabler for Vaporize (x2.0), Electro-Charged chains, Frozen lockdown, and spawning Dendro Cores (Bloom). Being in rain or water constantly refreshes Hydro!
codex.velorise_staves.elem.hydro.p2: • Innate Creatures: Drowned, Guardian, Elder Guardian. Extinguishes burning targets and fire blocks.
codex.velorise_staves.elem.electro.title: Electro (Lightning) — Chain Arcs & Homing Triggers
codex.velorise_staves.elem.electro.p1: • Combat Role: Chains lightning across wet targets (Electro-Charged), triggers Overloaded blasts, lowers armor resistance (Superconduct), boosts Quicken (Aggravate), and converts Dendro Cores into homing missiles (Hyperbloom).
codex.velorise_staves.elem.electro.p2: • Special Physics: Shooting water electrifies the pool for 5 seconds, shocking all creatures inside.
codex.velorise_staves.elem.cryo.title: Cryo (Frost) — Slowdown, Freeze & Melt
codex.velorise_staves.elem.cryo.p1: • Combat Role: Applies -30% Movement Speed while active. Combines with Hydro to encase enemies in solid ice (Frozen), with Pyro for Melt (x2.0), and with Electro for Superconduct.
codex.velorise_staves.elem.cryo.p2: • Innate Creatures: Stray, Snow Golem. Freezes water surfaces into walkable Frosted Ice.
codex.velorise_staves.elem.dendro.title: Dendro (Nature) — Cores, Quicken & Burning
codex.velorise_staves.elem.dendro.p1: • Combat Role: 2-stage tactical element! Combines with Hydro to drop explosive Dendro Cores on the ground, with Electro to enter the Quicken state (+flat bonus damage), and with Pyro for continuous Burning.
codex.velorise_staves.elem.dendro.p2: • Innate Creatures: Bogged, Cave Spider, Poisonous creatures.
codex.velorise_staves.elem.anemo.title: Anemo (Wind) — Crowd Control & Elemental Swirl
codex.velorise_staves.elem.anemo.p1: • Combat Role: Triggers Swirl when hitting Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo—dealing bonus damage and spreading that element's Aura to all enemies within 5.0 blocks!
codex.velorise_staves.elem.geo.title: Geo (Earth) — Crystallize Shields & Ice Shatter
codex.velorise_staves.elem.geo.p1: • Combat Role: Hitting Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo drops a 3D Crystallize Shard; pick it up for a Golden Heart Absorption Shield (15s). Hitting a Frozen target triggers Shatter for heavy physical/geo burst!
codex.velorise_staves.elem.geo.p2: • Innate Creatures: Warden, Iron Golem, Shulker, Silverfish.
codex.velorise_staves.react.vaporize.p1: • Forward Vaporize (Fire Aura + Water Hit): Multiplies your attack damage by x2.0 and consumes the Fire Aura completely.
codex.velorise_staves.react.vaporize.p2: • Reverse Vaporize (Water Aura + Fire Hit): Multiplies attack damage by x1.5 and only consumes half the Water Aura (lets you Vaporize twice in a row!).
codex.velorise_staves.react.melt.title: Melt (Cryo + Pyro) — Amplifying Damage
codex.velorise_staves.react.melt.p1: • Forward Melt (Frost Aura + Fire Hit): Multiplies your Fire attack damage by x2.0 and clears the Frost Aura.
codex.velorise_staves.react.melt.p2: • Reverse Melt (Fire Aura + Frost Hit): Multiplies Frost attack damage by x1.5 while leaving remaining Fire Aura.
codex.velorise_staves.react.overvape.p1: • Dual Reaction: When a target has both Hydro & Electro (from Electro-Charged), hitting them with Pyro triggers BOTH x2.0 Vaporize AND an Overloaded AoE explosion simultaneously!
codex.velorise_staves.react.overloaded.p: • Detonates a volatile blast across a 3.0m radius, dealing heavy bonus damage, launching enemies into the air, and melting nearby ice/igniting TNT.
codex.velorise_staves.react.electro_char: Electro-Charged (Hydro + Electro) — Dual Aura & Chain Arc
• Both Hydro & Electro remain active together! Shocks the target every 1.0s and arcs 3D purple lightning to nearby wet enemies within 5.0m.
codex.velorise_staves.react.frozen.title: Frozen & Shatter (Hydro + Cryo ➔ +Geo)
codex.velorise_staves.react.frozen.p1: • Frozen: Locks the target in solid ice (cannot move or attack). Players can mash [SPACE] to break free early!
codex.velorise_staves.react.frozen.p2: • Shatter: Hitting a Frozen enemy with Geo or an explosion shatters the ice for massive burst damage!
codex.velorise_staves.react.superconduct: • Releases a 4.0m cryogenic shockwave and applies Weakness (targets take +25% increased damage from all sources for 12 seconds).
codex.velorise_staves.react.swirl.title: Swirl (Anemo + Pyro / Hydro / Electro / Cryo)
codex.velorise_staves.react.swirl.p1: • Infuses the wind with the target's element, dealing AoE damage and spreading that elemental Aura to all creatures within 5.0m.
codex.velorise_staves.react.bloom.title: Bloom (Dendro + Hydro) — Spawns Dendro Core
codex.velorise_staves.react.bloom.p1: • Produces a Dendro Core seed on the ground (up to 5 active cores; explodes automatically after 5s in a 3.0m AoE, or if a 6th core is created).
codex.velorise_staves.react.burgeon.titl: Burgeon (Dendro Core + Pyro Hit) — Mega AoE Blast
codex.velorise_staves.react.burgeon.p1: • Hitting a Dendro Core on the ground with any Pyro attack instantly detonates a massive 4.0m thermal explosion for double damage!
codex.velorise_staves.react.hyperbloom.t: Hyperbloom (Dendro Core + Electro Hit) — Homing Missile
codex.velorise_staves.react.hyperbloom.p: • Hitting a Dendro Core with Electro transforms it into a high-precision homing projectile that tracks down the nearest enemy within 12m!
codex.velorise_staves.react.catalyze.p1: • Step 1 — Quicken: Combining Dendro + Electro energizes the target with a green Quicken Aura for 8–10s without consuming it.
codex.velorise_staves.react.catalyze.p2: • Step 2 — Aggravate / Spread: Hitting a Quickened target with Electro triggers Aggravate (+bonus DMG); hitting with Dendro triggers Spread (+higher bonus DMG)!
codex.velorise_staves.react.burning.p1: • Fuels a fierce fire that deals rapid damage every 0.5 seconds (10 ticks), maintains Pyro Aura, and ignites surrounding dry brush.
• Spawns a spinning 3D Elemental Crystal Shard on the ground.
• Walk over the shard to gain a 15-second Elemental Shield (Golden Absorption Hearts) with a matching colored border in your HUD!
codex.velorise_staves.env.pyro_melt.titl: Pyro Physics I: Melting Ice, Snow & Cauldrons
codex.velorise_staves.env.pyro_melt.p1: • Pyro projectiles, lingering fire fields, and thermal blasts (Overloaded, Burgeon, Burning, Pyro Swirl) melt Ice & Frosted Ice into Water (or steam in the Nether) and downgrade Packed Ice into regular Ice.
codex.velorise_staves.env.pyro_melt.p2: • Melts Snow layers, Snow Blocks, and Powder Snow, and converts Powder Snow Cauldrons directly into Water Cauldrons!
codex.velorise_staves.env.pyro_burn.titl: Pyro Physics II: Flammable Materials, TNT & Campfires
codex.velorise_staves.env.pyro_burn.p1: • Automatically lights unlit Campfires & Candles, primes TNT blocks to explode immediately, and burns away Cobwebs & Dead Bushes.
codex.velorise_staves.env.pyro_burn.p2: • Ignites flammable blocks (Logs, Planks, Leaves, Wool, Carpets, Hay Bales, Bookshelves, Scaffolding) when gamerule doFireTick is enabled.
codex.velorise_staves.env.hydro_cryo.tit: Hydro & Cryo Physics: Rain, Dousing & Frost Bridges
codex.velorise_staves.env.hydro_cryo.p1: • Standing in water or rain continuously applies Hydro Aura and douses fire. Cryo attacks freeze water source blocks into walkable Frosted Ice.
• Firing an Electro staff into water creates an Electrified Water zone for 5s, periodically shocking and drawing lightning arcs between all creatures in the water.
codex.velorise_staves.staff.inferno: Fires a blazing fireball that applies Pyro, melts ice, and ignites flammable blocks.

codex.velorise_staves.staff.guardian: Channels a high-velocity Hydro laser beam that pierces water and douses flames.
codex.velorise_staves.staff.frostbolt: Shoots a chilling Cryo bolt that slows targets (-30% SPD) and freezes water.
codex.velorise_staves.staff.arc: Strikes with an instant Electro lightning bolt that electrifies water pools.
codex.velorise_staves.staff.dragonfire: Fires an Ender Dragon Electro-plasma orb that leaves a lingering Electro dragonfire cloud.
codex.velorise_staves.staff.wither: Launches a decaying Dendro skull that inflicts Wither and applies Dendro Aura.
codex.velorise_staves.staff.webcaster: Entangles targets in temporary cobwebs while applying Dendro Aura for Bloom/Quicken combos.
codex.velorise_staves.staff.wind: Unleashes a Breeze wind charge that knocks targets back and triggers AoE Swirl.
codex.velorise_staves.staff.echo: Releases a Warden sonic boom that pierces armor/walls and triggers high-damage Anemo Swirl.
codex.velorise_staves.staff.shulker: Fires a homing Anemo Shulker bullet that levitates targets and triggers Swirl.
codex.velorise_staves.staff.evoker: Summons a line of Geo Evoker Fangs from the ground, triggering Crystallize shields & Shatter.
codex.velorise_staves.staff.utility.p1: • Void Translocator: Instant blink teleport (%sm Basic / %sm Netherite) with fall-damage reset.
codex.velorise_staves.staff.utility.p2: • Magic Mirror: Channels recall to your Bed/Spawn (Cooldown: %ss; Netherite supports cross-dimension recall).
codex.velorise_staves.mastery.card1.p1: • Amplifying (Vaporize, Melt, Overvape): +15% per level (Lvl I: +15% | Lvl II: +30% | Lvl III: +45% multiplier).
codex.velorise_staves.mastery.card1.p2: • Transformative (Overloaded, Electro-Charged, Superconduct, Swirl, Shatter, Bloom, Burgeon, Hyperbloom, Burning): +30% per level (Lvl I: +30% | Lvl II: +60% | Lvl III: +90% damage).
codex.velorise_staves.mastery.card1.p3: • Catalyze / Additive (Aggravate, Spread): +25% per level (Lvl I: +25% | Lvl II: +50% | Lvl III: +75% flat bonus).
codex.velorise_staves.mastery.card2.titl: How to Obtain Elemental Mastery & Codex in Survival
codex.velorise_staves.mastery.card2.p1: • Elemental Mastery I–III: Enchant any of the 24 combat staves directly at an Enchanting Table (Weight 5), trade with Librarian Villagers, or find Enchanted Books in Dungeon/Ancient City/Stronghold loot chests & fishing.
codex.velorise_staves.mastery.card2.p2: • Elemental Codex Recipe: Automatically granted on first world join, or craft Shapeless with 1x Book + 1x Amethyst Shard.
codex.velorise_staves.mastery.card3.p1: • All damage values, cooldowns, ranges, and durabilities shown in this Codex and on item tooltips automatically synchronize with the active Server configuration!
